Event: Every Chest mined gives 1.5x TP

🌍VIP Servers are free, and the world saves even if the server shuts down in VIP servers! Note: Game updates may require me to reset saved worlds due to significant world changes
[E] to use jetpack
[LEFT SHIFT] to run
[LEFT CONTROL] to create a platform to stand on
(You can hold mouse click to mine, no need to click repeatedly)

This game is designed to be performant and never require the world/mine to fully reset.

Game's music composed by Lahira
